A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] began their full invasion of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] territory, pressing out from their victory during the [[Taris Siege]]. One of the prongs of their assault sent them through Obroa.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the course of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose. In the ''Atlas'', the Obroa system is denoted as the "Obroa-skai system"<ref name="Atlas" /> after the planet of [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], which it contains.
